0417Work skills

Five Desks v3

rca-umb/five-desks

Solve procedurally generated tasks across eight domains where one hidden caveat, such as a late email or errata line, changes the right answer.

Open on Hugging FaceHow to run it

Good for

  • OpenEnv Arena training
  • teaching look-before-answering

Reward

How it is scored
Programmatic check
Signal
Graded, 0 to 1

Right answers score 1 with partial credit for partly right multi-part answers; the reasoning hint never changes the reward.

How to run it

1. From the cardcopied from the publisher's own instructions

docker run --rm -p 8000:8000 ghcr.io/rca-umb/five-desks:v2
openenv validate --url http://localhost:8000
python source/scripts/replay_v2.py --url http://localhost:8000

2. Get the filesthe whole repository, to a local folder

hf download rca-umb/five-desks --repo-type dataset --local-dir five-desks

Framework documentation: OpenEnv. Needs: Docker.

Evidence

Scripted solutions score 1 over 25 seeds per task id and a fuzzer sent 3,045 hostile calls with 0 failures; arena score was 1/40.

As reported by the publisher. We have not reproduced it.
